reason: The commit replaces inet_addr-based IPv4 parsing with ares_inet_pton and includes whitespace-only edits. It introduces no new public entry point, protocol, initialization requirement, configuration requirement, or harness input contract. The existing fuzzers continue to invoke their original high-level targets—ares_parse_*_reply and ares_create_query—with valid setup. Although those harnesses do not directly exercise the changed host lookup, address-info, and initialization paths, that was already true before the commit; this internal parsing/validation change alone does not make the existing harness inadequate for its intended targets.
evidence: test/ares-test-fuzz.c continues to cover the ares_parse_*_reply family using arbitrary input data and performs the corresponding frees.
test/ares-test-fuzz-name.c continues to pass a NUL-terminated fuzz-controlled name to ares_create_query; the commit does not alter that API or its requirements.
ares__get_hostent, ares__readaddrinfo, fake_addrinfo, fake_hostent, and ip_addr only replace inet_addr calls with ares_inet_pton(AF_INET, ...).
The remaining edits in ares_gethostbyname.c and ares_init.c remove trailing whitespace or update comments; they do not alter harness-facing behavior.
recommended_action: Keep the existing fuzz harness and OSS-Fuzz wiring unchanged for this commit; any separate expansion to fuzz host lookup or configuration parsing would be optional coverage work, not required maintenance.
